sonnet.problem: The story cards never tell verses 7-9. After card 11 (verse 6), the baker meets three choice cards in a row that all come from Jesus' unseen words. Card 14 is a true/false line that just states verse 9. A baker has no way to reason it out, so the pick is luck. The True statement also restates a fact the baker was never given.
sonnet.rule: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.
